bids.title: IFB 112-27 Fire Station 95 Interior Renovation
bids.description: The City of Henderson, Nevada, is requesting bids from qualified companies to perform an interior renovation of Fire Station 95, located at 2300 Pebble Road, Henderson, Nevada. The Project consists of renovating and reconfiguring approximately one hundred sixty (160) square feet of the existing Day Room to create two (2) private dorm rooms for fire personnel. Each dorm room will include a separate alerting system, individual climate controls, insulated wall assemblies meeting the required Sound Transmission Class (STC) rating, an acoustic tile ceiling system, a ceiling fan, and a lockable door. All Work is considered Base Bid with no alternate bid items. The Project is identified as Public Works Project No. PWP-CL-2026-499. Project estimate is $85,000. Duration: 60 days

bids.description: Truckee Meadows Water Authority (TMWA) is accepting sealed bids for all labor, materials, equipment, and incidentals required to drill, construct, develop, and test pump two (2) production wells via the dual-tube air flooded reverse drilling method employing concentric dual-wall drill pipe. The wells will be constructed of stainless-steel casing and screen, glass beads, and range from 10 inches I.D. to 14 inches I.D.and 250 ft. to 530 ft. in depth. The wells will be drilled within 100 ft of existing production wells that will not be operational during drilling but must be preserved for future use.

bids.title: FLAMINGO WASH - UNIVERSITY CENTER DRIVE TO PALOS VERDES STREET
bids.description: Clark County invites qualified firms or individuals to submit bids. Questions regarding this bid must be directed to the Bid Contact listed in this bid. The work to be performed under this contract consists of channel improvements for the Flamingo Wash located between University Center Drive and Palos Verdes Street including, reinforced concrete channel and culvert extensions from the three 10-foot by 7-foot RCB under University Center Avenue to the five 12-foot by 8-foot RCB under Palos Verdes Street, a paved trail along the north side of the Flamingo Wash, and maintenance roads and access ramps. Improvements will generally consist of reinforced concrete channel, storm drain facilities, reinforced concrete box, reinforced concrete pipes, drop inlets, manholes, asphaltic concrete pavement, fencing, conduit, pull boxes, signing, striping and monitoring equipment, and other related items of work within the unincorporated area of Clark County, Nevada.
